outgoing.name: Austria
outgoing.excerpt: In 1885, the Austrian chemist baron Carl Auer von Welsbach separated didymium into two elements, praseodymium and neodymium, which gave salts of different colors.

outgoing.name: Greece
outgoing.excerpt: The name praseodymium comes from the Greek prasios, meaning green, and didymos, or twin.
